```js
"use strict";
self["rspackHotUpdate"]("workerA_js", {
"./moduleA.js"(__unused_rspack_module, __webpack_exports__, __webpack_require__) {
__webpack_require__.r(__webpack_exports__);
__webpack_require__.d(__webpack_exports__, {
  "default": () => (__rspack_default_export)
});
/* export default */ const __rspack_default_export = (3);


},

},function(__webpack_require__) {
// webpack/runtime/get javascript chunk filename
(() => {
// This function allow to reference chunks
__webpack_require__.u = (chunkId) => {
  var filename = (function() {
  // return url for filenames not based on template
  
  // return url for filenames based on template
  return "" + chunkId + ".chunk." + __webpack_require__.h() + ".js"
  })();
  var version = ({"shared":"CHUNK_HASH"})[chunkId];
  if (!version) return filename;
  var query = filename.search(/[?#]/);
  var path = query < 0 ? filename : filename.slice(0, query);
  var directory = path.lastIndexOf("/") + 1;
  return path.slice(0, directory) + version + ".hot-chunk." + path.slice(directory) + (query < 0 ? "" : filename.slice(query));
}

})();
// webpack/runtime/get_full_hash
(() => {
__webpack_require__.h = () => ("CURRENT_HASH")
})();

}
);
```
